question.text: Incandescent bulbs are designed by keeping in mind that the resistance of their filament increases with the increase in temperature. If at room temperature, $100 \mathrm{~W}, 60 \mathrm{~W}$ and $40 \mathrm{~W}$ bulbs have filament resistances $R_{100}, R_{60}$ and $R_{40}$, respectively, the relation between these resistances is

solution.text:
$R=\frac{V^2}{P}$ or $R \propto \frac{1}{P}$ $\therefore \quad \frac{1}{R_{100}}>\frac{1}{R_{60}}>\frac{1}{R_{40}}$
Hence, the correct option is (d).
